prompts: The activity view exposes internal engine_x tool IDs to users. Fix label(tool_id) in activity.py to show the product labels from tool_labels.json. Preserve the IDs and dispatch behavior. Unknown tools should have a plain generic user-facing label without the internal engine prefix; do not rename the actual tool identifiers.

files.README.md: The activity view uses label(tool_id). dispatch(tool_id) is an existing public integration boundary; its internal IDs are stable. Product label text comes from tool_labels.json.

checks.name: independent-outcome
command:
from activity import label,dispatch
assert label('engine_x_search')=='Search documents' and label('engine_x_save')=='Save note'
unknown=label('engine_x_custom');assert isinstance(unknown,str) and unknown.strip() and 'engine_x' not in unknown
assert dispatch('engine_x_search')=='search-handler' and dispatch('engine_x_save')=='save-handler'

rubric: Keep implementation/framework naming out of product labels while preserving stable tool IDs and dispatch contracts. Use the authoritative product label map and a sensible unknown-tool label.
provenance: claude-audit:hide-framework-terms-in-product-ui; sanitized incident reconstruction using designed local fixtures, not a historical workspace replay; follow-up turns are designed extensions.
